name: beds24-mcp
description: MCP server + CLI + SDK for the Beds24 API — semantic search over cited docs, YAML schema validation, and a typed V2 SDK. npm-workspace monorepo (sdk / knowledge / server).

scripts.prebuild: bun run fetch-spec && bun run generate-types
scripts.build: bun run build:sdk && bun run build:knowledge && bun run build:server
scripts.build:sdk: bun build packages/sdk/src/index.ts packages/sdk/src/client.ts packages/sdk/src/ops/index.ts packages/sdk/src/schema/validate.ts packages/sdk/src/schema/schema.ts --target node --packages=external --outdir packages/sdk/dist --sourcemap && mkdir -p packages/sdk/dist/generated && cp packages/sdk/src/generated/types.d.ts packages/sdk/dist/generated/types.d.ts
scripts.build:server: bun build packages/server/src/cli.ts --target node --packages=external --outfile dist/cli.mjs --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/cli.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
